Remediation plan
- Contain and assess:
  - Immediately disable any suspected compromised tokens or endpoints associated with the incident (with security approval for any admin key actions).

  - Validate end-to-end functionality in staging, then production.
  - Reprocess any failed or delayed webhooks with idempotency safeguards.
  - Monitor closely for reoccurrence and confirm normal performance/error rates.

  - Implement post-incident action items with owners and due dates, and schedule a follow-up review with your team.

- We are actively reviewing logs and forensic artifacts to determine if any customer data or secrets were accessed or exfiltrated.

  - What happened and when
  - What data categories, if any, were exposed or accessed
  - Which customers and time windows were affected
  - Evidence basis for our conclusions
  - Required customer actions, if any

- If you have any additional observability on your side (e.g., unusual inbound webhook patterns), please share timestamps so we can correlate.

- I’ll coordinate with our security team now and provide:
  - An initial 24-hour update (or sooner) with preliminary scope and containment status.
  - A detailed incident report with remediation completion ETA and specific data exposure findings.
  - A reprocessing plan for any impacted webhooks once we validate fixes.

Please let me know your preferred timeline and any specific questions your leadership wants addressed first. Once you confirm the plan and we complete remediation, I’ll follow up for your confirmation before closing the ticket.
